comparison.objective: Cross two trailer safety chains under the tongue and hook each opposite-side end link onto a pin; candidate removes four tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual chain routing, crossing, and link-over-pin placement versus precision recessed tooling, impact regulation, and tiny-fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Chains cross, opposite end links are hooked, neither chain touches the table, and both are released versus four contained fractures with no damage.
comparison.reason: Hook/link placement shares generic alignment but tests deformable chain topology rather than fracture of a retained metal feature. No spec versions or hook-retention tolerances are supplied.
